-- ── Strings (GlobalStrings.lua, verbatim) ─────────────────────────────────────────────── -- %s summoner · %s area · %d count · %s the count's unit word (StaticPopupTimeUnit). local CONFIRM_SUMMON = "%s wants to summon you to %s. The spell will be cancelled in %d %s." -- l.852 local ACCEPT = "Accept" -- l.11 local CANCEL = "Cancel" -- l.465
-- ── The confirm — answering to StaticPopup.lua l.1336-1357 ───────────────────────────── -- OnShow seeds `timeleft` from the engine, which is what arms the popup engine's countdown -- branch; from there the dialog ticks it down locally and hides itself at zero, sending -- nothing. GetSummonConfirmTimeLeft() returns whole seconds, already truncated by the -- binding (`0x48b660`), so this is the reference's own resolution and not a rounding of ours. -- -- The OnUpdate is a COMBAT LOCK, not a teardown: you may not accept a summon while -- fighting, so Button1 disables and re-enables while the dialog stays up. Every other -- confirm in this folder polls to decide whether to *hide*; this one polls to decide -- whether the answer is available. Cancel stays live throughout. local function lockAcceptWhileInCombat(_, dialog) local button = getglobal(dialog:GetName() .. "Button1") if UnitAffectingCombat("player") then button:Disable() else button:Enable() end end
StaticPopupDialogs["CONFIRM_SUMMON"] = { text = CONFIRM_SUMMON, button1 = ACCEPT, button2 = CANCEL, OnShow = function() this.timeleft = GetSummonConfirmTimeLeft() end, OnAccept = function() ConfirmSummon() end, OnUpdate = lockAcceptWhileInCombat, timeout = 0, -- A summon is worth interrupting a fly-by for: without this the whole question would be -- cancelled unseen by StaticPopup_Show's cinematic gate, and the offer would expire -- while the player watched a cutscene. interruptCinematic = 1, -- v1-inert in our engine (UiPanels.xml's header lists it) — transcribed because it is -- part of the entry an addon may read. notClosableByLogout = 1, hideOnEscape = 1, }
-- ── The UIParent event arm (UIParent.lua l.551-552) ──────────────────────────────────── -- No arguments: the getters above are the payload. function BenillaConfirmSummonDriver_OnEvent() if event == "CONFIRM_SUMMON" then StaticPopup_Show("CONFIRM_SUMMON") end end
